        <script><![CDATA[var IllumioTestUtils = Class.create();
IllumioTestUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    constants: function() {
        return {
            pceConfigSysId: 'f926c944c316031050bffa0ed40131aa',
            table: 'cmdb_ci_server',
            prefix: '202607271619',
            seedCount: 8000,
            values: [
              { field: 'os',          data: ['HP-UX', 'FreeBSD', 'z/OS', 'macOS'] },
              { field: 'environment', data: ['Development', 'UAT', 'Pre-Prod', 'Sandbox'] },
              { field: 'os_version',  data: ['11i v3', '14.1', '2.5', 'Ventura 13.4'] },
              { field: 'os_domain',   data: ['corp.na', 'corp.mena', 'corp.anz', 'corp.nordic'] },
              { field: 'cpu_type',    data: ['PA-RISC', 'AMD EPYC', 'IBM z16', 'Apple M2'] }
            ]
        };
    },

    /**
     * Seed dummy CI records into a CMDB table for regression testing.
     *
     * Creates `count` records distributed evenly across batches. The number of
     * batches is determined by the length of each `data` array in `values` (all
     * must be the same length). Each batch gets `count / numBatches` records,
     * with any remainder added to the first batches.
     *
     * Every record gets a unique hostname: `<prefix>-<NNN>` (zero-padded to 3+
     * digits), which serves as the primary key for later querying and cleanup.
     *
     * Example:
     *   seed('cmdb_ci_server', 100, 'regtest-REG-1720500000', [
     *     { field: 'os',          data: ['Windows', 'Linux', 'macOS'] },
     *     { field: 'environment', data: ['Production', 'Development', 'Staging'] }
     *   ])
     *   // Creates 100 CIs across 3 batches (34, 33, 33), each batch getting
     *   // the corresponding os + environment combination.
     *
     * @param {String} table   - API name of the CI table (e.g. 'cmdb_ci_server')
     * @param {Number} count   - Total number of records to create
     * @param {String} prefix  - Hostname prefix for test isolation (e.g. 'regtest-REG-1720500000')
     * @param {Array}  values  - Array of { field: String, data: String[] } objects.
     *                           `field` is the column name on `table`.
     *                           `data` is an array of values, one per batch.
     *                           All `data` arrays must be the same length.
     *
     * @returns {Object} {
     *   total:   Number,          // total records created
     *   batches: [                 // one entry per batch
     *     {
     *       index:  Number,        // 0-based batch index
     *       sysIds: String[],      // sys_ids of created records
     *       values: Object         // { field: value } applied to this batch
     *     }
     *   ]
     * }
     *
     * @throws {Error} if `values` is empty, `data` arrays differ in length,
     *                  or `count` < number of batches
     */
    seed: function(table, count, prefix, values) {
        if (!values || values.length === 0) {
            throw new Error('values must be a non-empty array');
        }

        var numBatches = values[0].data.length;

        for (var v = 0; v < values.length; v++) {
            if (values[v].data.length !== numBatches) {
                throw new Error(
                    'All data arrays must be the same length. ' +
                    '"' + values[v].field + '" has ' + values[v].data.length +
                    ' entries but expected ' + numBatches
                );
            }
        }

        if (count < numBatches) {
            throw new Error('count (' + count + ') must be >= number of batches (' + numBatches + ')');
        }

        var baseSize = Math.floor(count / numBatches);
        var remainder = count % numBatches;
        var padWidth = Math.max(3, String(count).length);
        var globalIndex = 1;
        var batches = [];

        for (var b = 0; b < numBatches; b++) {
            var batchSize = baseSize + (b < remainder ? 1 : 0);
            var batchValues = {};
            for (var vi = 0; vi < values.length; vi++) {
                batchValues[values[vi].field] = values[vi].data[b];
            }

            var sysIds = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < batchSize; i++) {
                var hostname = prefix + '-' + this._zeroPad(globalIndex, padWidth);
                var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
                gr.initialize();
                gr.setValue('name', hostname);

                for (var field in batchValues) {
                    gr.setValue(field, batchValues[field]);
                }

                var sysId = gr.insert();
                if (sysId) {
                    sysIds.push(sysId + '');
                } else {
                    gs.warn('[IllumioTestUtils.seed] Failed to insert record #' + globalIndex + ' into ' + table);
                }

                globalIndex++;
            }

            batches.push({
                index: b,
                sysIds: sysIds,
                values: batchValues
            });

            gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.seed] Batch ' + b + ': created ' + sysIds.length + ' records in ' + table);
        }

        var total = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < batches.length; t++) {
            total += batches[t].sysIds.length;
        }

        gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.seed] Done. Total: ' + total + ' records in ' + table + ' with prefix "' + prefix + '"');

        return {
            total: total,
            batches: batches
        };
    },

    /**
     * Count records in a table whose `name` field starts with the given prefix.
     *
     * Useful for verifying that `seed()` created the expected number of records
     * before running cleanup.
     *
     * @param {String} table  - API name of the table (e.g. 'cmdb_ci_server')
     * @param {String} prefix - The hostname prefix used during seeding (e.g. 'regtest-seed-test')
     * @returns {Number} count of matching records
     */
    count: function(table, prefix) {
        var ga = new GlideAggregate(table);
        ga.addQuery('name', 'STARTSWITH', prefix);
        ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
        ga.query();

        var total = 0;
        if (ga.next()) {
            total = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);
        }

        gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.count] Found ' + total + ' records in ' + table + ' with prefix "' + prefix + '"');
        return total;
    },

    /**
     * Delete all records from a table whose `name` field starts with the given prefix.
     *
     * Intended for cleaning up records created by `seed()`. Deletes one record
     * at a time (not bulk) so that business rules and cascading deletes fire normally.
     *
     * @param {String} table  - API name of the table (e.g. 'cmdb_ci_server')
     * @param {String} prefix - The hostname prefix used during seeding (e.g. 'regtest-seed-test')
     * @returns {Number} count of deleted records
     */
    cleanup: function(table, prefix) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        gr.addQuery('name', 'STARTSWITH', prefix);
        gr.query();

        var deleted = 0;
        while (gr.next()) {
            gr.deleteRecord();
            deleted++;
        }

        gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.cleanup] Deleted ' + deleted + ' records from ' + table + ' with prefix "' + prefix + '"');
        return deleted;
    },

    /**
     * Validate that all workloads matched by active inclusion sync filters for a
     * PCE Configuration have been successfully synced.
     *
     * Reads all active inclusion sync filters, calls getWorkloadsBySyncFilter for
     * each, deduplicates the workload sys_ids, then checks every matched workload
     * has conflicts=false and known_to_pce is 'managed' or 'unmanaged'.
     *
     * @param {String} pceConfigId - sys_id of the PCE Configuration record
     * @returns {Object} {
     *   passed:       Boolean,     // true if all matched workloads are synced correctly
     *   total:        Number,      // total unique workloads matched across all filters
     *   synced:       Number,      // workloads with conflicts=false and known_to_pce in (managed, unmanaged)
     *   failures:     Array,       // details of each failing workload: { sys_id, hostname, conflicts, known_to_pce }
     *   filterBreakdown: Array     // per-filter summary: { filterSysId, filterName, workloadCount }
     * }
     */
    validateSyncFilters: function(pceConfigId) {
        var utils = new IllumioUtils();
        var result = {
            passed: false,
            total: 0,
            synced: 0,
            failures: [],
            filterBreakdown: []
        };

        var sfGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_sync_filter');
        sfGr.addQuery('pce_configuration', pceConfigId);
        sfGr.addQuery('type', 'inclusion');
        sfGr.addQuery('active', true);
        sfGr.query();

        var allSysIds = {};

        while (sfGr.next()) {
            var filterSysId = sfGr.getUniqueValue();
            var filterName = sfGr.getValue('name');

            var filterResult = utils.getWorkloadsBySyncFilter(filterSysId);
            var filterCount = 0;

            if (filterResult.success) {
                for (var i = 0; i < filterResult.workloads.length; i++) {
                    var sysId = filterResult.workloads[i].sys_id;
                    allSysIds[sysId] = true;
                    filterCount++;
                }
            }

            result.filterBreakdown.push({
                filterSysId: filterSysId,
                filterName: filterName,
                workloadCount: filterCount
            });

            gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.validateSyncFilters] Filter "' + filterName + '": ' + filterCount + ' workloads');
        }

        var uniqueSysIds = Object.keys(allSysIds);
        result.total = uniqueSysIds.length;

        if (uniqueSysIds.length === 0) {
            gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.validateSyncFilters] No workloads matched any inclusion filter');
            result.passed = true;
            return result;
        }

        var wlGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_pce_workload');
        wlGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', uniqueSysIds.join(','));
        wlGr.query();

        while (wlGr.next()) {
            var conflicts = wlGr.getValue('conflicts');
            var knownToPce = wlGr.getValue('known_to_pce');

            if (conflicts == 'false' && (knownToPce == 'managed' || knownToPce == 'unmanaged')) {
                result.synced++;
            } else {
                result.failures.push({
                    sys_id: wlGr.getUniqueValue(),
                    hostname: wlGr.getValue('hostname'),
                    conflicts: conflicts,
                    known_to_pce: knownToPce
                });
            }
        }

        result.passed = result.failures.length === 0;

        gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.validateSyncFilters] Result: ' + result.synced + '/' + result.total + ' synced. ' +
            (result.passed ? 'PASSED' : 'FAILED — ' + result.failures.length + ' workload(s) with issues'));

        return result;
    },

    /**
     * Validate sync filter behavior for a PCE Configuration after discovery+sync.
     *
     * Assesses BOTH sides of the filter boundary:
     *   1. INCLUDED workloads (matched by any active inclusion filter) should have
     *      been synced: conflicts=false, known_to_pce = 'managed' or 'unmanaged'.
     *   2. EXCLUDED workloads (all other workloads for this config, not matched by
     *      any filter) should be untouched: known_to_pce = 'unknown'.
     *
     * This two-sided check ensures the filter is both letting the right workloads
     * through AND blocking the ones it should.
     *
     * @param {String} pceConfigId - sys_id of the PCE Configuration record
     * @param {String} prefix     - Hostname prefix to scope the assessment to only
     *                              seeded workloads (e.g. 'regtest-seed-test'). Only
     *                              workloads whose hostname starts with this prefix
     *                              are evaluated; all others are ignored.
     * @returns {Object} {
     *   passed:           Boolean,  // true only if BOTH included and excluded checks pass
     *   included: {
     *     total:          Number,   // unique workloads matched across all filters
     *     synced:         Number,   // matched workloads correctly synced
     *     failures:       Array     // matched workloads NOT synced: { sys_id, hostname, conflicts, known_to_pce }
     *   },
     *   excluded: {
     *     total:          Number,   // workloads NOT matched by any filter
     *     untouched:      Number,   // excluded workloads correctly left alone
     *     failures:       Array     // excluded workloads that were synced when they shouldn't have been
     *   },
     *   filterBreakdown:  Array     // per-filter summary: { filterSysId, filterName, workloadCount }
     * }
     */
    validateSyncFiltersFullAssessment: function(pceConfigId, prefix) {
        var utils = new IllumioUtils();
        var result = {
            passed: false,
            included: { total: 0, synced: 0, failures: [] },
            excluded: { total: 0, untouched: 0, failures: [] },
            filterBreakdown: []
        };

        // Step 1: Collect all workload sys_ids matched by inclusion filters
        var sfGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_sync_filter');
        sfGr.addQuery('pce_configuration', pceConfigId);
        sfGr.addQuery('type', 'inclusion');
        sfGr.addQuery('active', true);
        sfGr.query();

        var includedSysIds = {};

        while (sfGr.next()) {
            var filterSysId = sfGr.getUniqueValue();
            var filterName = sfGr.getValue('name');

            var filterResult = utils.getWorkloadsBySyncFilter(filterSysId);
            var filterCount = 0;

            if (filterResult.success) {
                for (var i = 0; i < filterResult.workloads.length; i++) {
                    var wl = filterResult.workloads[i];
                    if (wl.hostname && (wl.hostname + '').indexOf(prefix) === 0) {
                        includedSysIds[wl.sys_id] = true;
                        filterCount++;
                    }
                }
            }

            result.filterBreakdown.push({
                filterSysId: filterSysId,
                filterName: filterName,
                workloadCount: filterCount
            });

            gs.info('[validateSyncFiltersFullAssessment] Filter "' + filterName + '": ' + filterCount + ' workloads');
        }

        // Step 2: Query workloads scoped to the prefix and split into included vs excluded
        var allWlGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_pce_workload');
        allWlGr.addQuery('illumio_pce_configuration', pceConfigId);
        allWlGr.addQuery('duplicate', false);
        allWlGr.addQuery('hostname', 'STARTSWITH', prefix);
        allWlGr.query();

        while (allWlGr.next()) {
            var wlSysId = allWlGr.getUniqueValue();
            var hostname = allWlGr.getValue('hostname');
            var conflicts = allWlGr.getValue('conflicts');
            var knownToPce = allWlGr.getValue('known_to_pce');

            if (includedSysIds[wlSysId]) {
                // INCLUDED: should be synced (known_to_pce=managed|unmanaged, conflicts=false/0)
                result.included.total++;
                if ((knownToPce == 'managed' || knownToPce == 'unmanaged') && (conflicts == 'false' || conflicts == '0' || conflicts == false)) {
                    result.included.synced++;
                } else {
                    result.included.failures.push({
                        sys_id: wlSysId,
                        hostname: hostname,
                        conflicts: conflicts,
                        known_to_pce: knownToPce
                    });
                }
            } else {
                // EXCLUDED: should be untouched (known_to_pce=unknown)
                result.excluded.total++;
                if (knownToPce == 'unknown') {
                    result.excluded.untouched++;
                } else {
                    result.excluded.failures.push({
                        sys_id: wlSysId,
                        hostname: hostname,
                        conflicts: conflicts,
                        known_to_pce: knownToPce
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        result.passed = result.included.failures.length === 0 && result.excluded.failures.length === 0;

        gs.info('[validateSyncFiltersFullAssessment] INCLUDED: ' + result.included.synced + '/' + result.included.total + ' synced correctly');
        gs.info('[validateSyncFiltersFullAssessment] EXCLUDED: ' + result.excluded.untouched + '/' + result.excluded.total + ' untouched correctly');
        gs.info('[validateSyncFiltersFullAssessment] Result: ' + (result.passed ? 'PASSED' :
            'FAILED — ' + result.included.failures.length + ' included not synced, ' +
            result.excluded.failures.length + ' excluded wrongly synced'));

        return result;
    },

    /**
     * Extract config class mapping and field-to-label-dimension mapping for a
     * given PCE config + table combination.
     *
     * Returns which CI fields are mapped to label dimensions (and their
     * label_dimension sys_ids) so callers can decide whether to create label
     * filter items or workload field filter items.
     *
     * @param {String} pceConfigId - sys_id of the PCE Configuration
     * @param {String} table       - CMDB source table (e.g. 'cmdb_ci_server')
     * @returns {Object|null} null if no mapping found, otherwise:
     *   {
     *     classMappingSysId: String,
     *     labelFields: {
     *       '<fieldName>': { labelDimensionSysId: String, sysDictSysId: String },
     *       ...
     *     }
     *   }
     */
    getConfigFieldMappings: function(pceConfigId, table) {
        var configClassGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_config_class_mapping');
        configClassGr.addQuery('illumio_pce_configuration', pceConfigId);
        configClassGr.addQuery('source_table', table);
        configClassGr.addActiveQuery();
        configClassGr.query();

        if (!configClassGr.next()) {
            gs.warn('[IllumioTestUtils.getConfigFieldMappings] No config class mapping for table ' + table);
            return null;
        }

        var classMappingSysId = configClassGr.getUniqueValue();
        var labelFields = {};

        var mappingGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_class_field_mapping');
        mappingGr.addQuery('illumio_config_class_mapping', classMappingSysId);
        mappingGr.addQuery('type', 'label_dimension');
        mappingGr.addQuery('advanced', false);
        mappingGr.addActiveQuery();
        mappingGr.query();

        while (mappingGr.next()) {
            var fieldName = mappingGr.getValue('ci_field');
            if (gs.nil(fieldName)) continue;

            labelFields[fieldName] = {
                labelDimensionSysId: mappingGr.getValue('illumio_label_dimension')
            };
        }

        gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.getConfigFieldMappings] Found ' +
            Object.keys(labelFields).length + ' label-mapped fields for ' + table);

        return {
            classMappingSysId: classMappingSysId,
            labelFields: labelFields
        };
    },

    /**
     * Resolve the sys_dictionary sys_id for a given table + field name.
     *
     * Walks up the table hierarchy (cmdb_ci_server → cmdb_ci_computer →
     * cmdb_ci → ...) because fields like 'os' are defined on parent tables.
     *
     * @param {String} table   - Starting table name (e.g. 'cmdb_ci_server')
     * @param {String} element - Column/field name (e.g. 'os')
     * @returns {String|null} sys_id from sys_dictionary, or null if not found
     */
    getSysDictionarySysId: function(table, element) {
        var currentTable = table;
        while (!gs.nil(currentTable)) {
            var dictGr = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
            dictGr.addQuery('name', currentTable);
            dictGr.addQuery('element', element);
            dictGr.query();
            if (dictGr.next()) {
                return dictGr.getUniqueValue();
            }

            var tblGr = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object');
            tblGr.addQuery('name', currentTable);
            tblGr.query();
            if (tblGr.next() && !gs.nil(tblGr.getValue('super_class'))) {
                currentTable = tblGr.super_class.name + '';
            } else {
                currentTable = null;
            }
        }

        gs.warn('[IllumioTestUtils.getSysDictionarySysId] No sys_dictionary entry for ' + table + '.' + element);
        return null;
    },

    /**
     * Create a complete sync filter with groups and filter items, derived
     * automatically from the PCE config's class/field mappings and the
     * provided values array.
     *
     * Creates one group per batch (values[0].data.length groups). Each group
     * gets one filter item per field. If a field is label-mapped in the PCE
     * config, a label filter item is created; otherwise a workload field
     * filter item is created.
     *
     * @param {String} pceConfigId - sys_id of the PCE Configuration
     * @param {String} table       - CMDB source table (e.g. 'cmdb_ci_server')
     * @param {String} prefix      - Test prefix (used for naming filter/groups)
     * @param {String} type        - 'inclusion' or 'deletion'
     * @param {Array}  values      - Same format as seed(): [{ field, data[] }]
     * @returns {Object} {
     *   syncFilterSysId: String,
     *   groupCount:      Number,
     *   labelItemCount:  Number,
     *   fieldItemCount:  Number,
     *   groups:          Array  // [{ sysId, name, items: [{type, field, value}] }]
     * }
     */
    createSyncFilter: function(pceConfigId, table, prefix, type, values) {
        if (!values || values.length === 0) {
            throw new Error('values must be a non-empty array');
        }

        var numGroups = values[0].data.length;
        for (var v = 0; v < values.length; v++) {
            if (values[v].data.length !== numGroups) {
                throw new Error('All data arrays must be the same length');
            }
        }

        var mappings = this.getConfigFieldMappings(pceConfigId, table);
        if (!mappings) {
            throw new Error('No config class mapping found for table ' + table);
        }

        // Pre-resolve sys_dictionary sys_ids for non-label fields
        var sysDictCache = {};
        for (var vi = 0; vi < values.length; vi++) {
            var field = values[vi].field;
            if (!mappings.labelFields[field]) {
                sysDictCache[field] = this.getSysDictionarySysId(table, field);
                if (!sysDictCache[field]) {
                    throw new Error('No sys_dictionary entry found for ' + table + '.' + field);
                }
            }
        }

        // Create sync filter
        var sfGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_sync_filter');
        sfGr.initialize();
        sfGr.setValue('name', prefix + '-filter');
        sfGr.setValue('pce_configuration', pceConfigId);
        sfGr.setValue('type', type);
        sfGr.setValue('active', true);
        var sfSysId = sfGr.insert();

        if (!sfSysId) {
            throw new Error('Failed to create sync filter');
        }

        gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.createSyncFilter] Created sync filter: ' + sfSysId);

        var groups = [];
        var totalLabelItems = 0;
        var totalFieldItems = 0;

        for (var g = 0; g < numGroups; g++) {
            var groupGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_sync_filter_group');
            groupGr.initialize();
            groupGr.setValue('name', prefix + '-group-' + g);
            groupGr.setValue('sync_filter', sfSysId);
            groupGr.setValue('active', true);
            var groupSysId = groupGr.insert();

            var items = [];

            for (var fi = 0; fi < values.length; fi++) {
                var fld = values[fi].field;
                var val = values[fi].data[g];

                if (mappings.labelFields[fld]) {
                    var lfiGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_label_filter_item');
                    lfiGr.initialize();
                    lfiGr.setValue('illumio_sync_filter', sfSysId);
                    lfiGr.setValue('sync_filter_group', groupSysId);
                    lfiGr.setValue('label_dimension', mappings.labelFields[fld].labelDimensionSysId);
                    lfiGr.setValue('label_value', val);
                    lfiGr.setValue('active', true);
                    lfiGr.insert();
                    totalLabelItems++;
                    items.push({ type: 'label', field: fld, value: val });
                } else {
                    var wfGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_workload_field_filter_item');
                    wfGr.initialize();
                    wfGr.setValue('illumio_sync_filter', sfSysId);
                    wfGr.setValue('sync_filter_group', groupSysId);
                    wfGr.setValue('source_table', mappings.classMappingSysId);
                    wfGr.setValue('source_field', sysDictCache[fld]);
                    wfGr.setValue('source_value', val);
                    wfGr.setValue('active', true);
                    wfGr.insert();
                    totalFieldItems++;
                    items.push({ type: 'workload_field', field: fld, value: val });
                }
            }

            groups.push({ sysId: groupSysId, name: prefix + '-group-' + g, items: items });
        }

        gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.createSyncFilter] Created ' + numGroups + ' groups, ' +
            totalLabelItems + ' label items, ' + totalFieldItems + ' field items');

        return {
            syncFilterSysId: sfSysId,
            groupCount: numGroups,
            labelItemCount: totalLabelItems,
            fieldItemCount: totalFieldItems,
            groups: groups
        };
    },

    /**
     * Delete a sync filter and all its child records (groups, label filter
     * items, workload field filter items). Deletes bottom-up to respect
     * referential integrity.
     *
     * @param {String} syncFilterSysId - sys_id of the sync filter to delete
     * @returns {Object} { groups: Number, labelItems: Number, fieldItems: Number }
     */
    cleanupSyncFilter: function(syncFilterSysId) {
        var counts = { groups: 0, labelItems: 0, fieldItems: 0 };

        // Find all groups for this filter
        var groupGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_sync_filter_group');
        groupGr.addQuery('sync_filter', syncFilterSysId);
        groupGr.query();

        var groupSysIds = [];
        while (groupGr.next()) {
            groupSysIds.push(groupGr.getUniqueValue());
        }

        // Delete label filter items for all groups
        if (groupSysIds.length > 0) {
            var lfiGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_label_filter_item');
            lfiGr.addQuery('sync_filter_group', 'IN', groupSysIds.join(','));
            lfiGr.query();
            while (lfiGr.next()) {
                lfiGr.deleteRecord();
                counts.labelItems++;
            }

            // Delete workload field filter items for all groups
            var wfGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_workload_field_filter_item');
            wfGr.addQuery('sync_filter_group', 'IN', groupSysIds.join(','));
            wfGr.query();
            while (wfGr.next()) {
                wfGr.deleteRecord();
                counts.fieldItems++;
            }

            // Delete groups
            var delGroupGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_sync_filter_group');
            delGroupGr.addQuery('sync_filter', syncFilterSysId);
            delGroupGr.query();
            while (delGroupGr.next()) {
                delGroupGr.deleteRecord();
                counts.groups++;
            }
        }

        // Delete the sync filter itself
        var sfGr = new GlideRecord('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_sync_filter');
        if (sfGr.get(syncFilterSysId)) {
            sfGr.deleteRecord();
        }

        gs.info('[IllumioTestUtils.cleanupSyncFilter] Deleted: ' + counts.groups + ' groups, ' +
            counts.labelItems + ' label items, ' + counts.fieldItems + ' field items');

        return counts;
    },

    _zeroPad: function(num, width) {
        var s = String(num);
        while (s.length < width) {
            s = '0' + s;
        }
        return s;
    },

    type: "IllumioTestUtils"
};
